home.title: Treasure Hunt
home.locationPermissionMessage: Treasure Hunt uses GPS to place and track treasure locations near you.

clues: Start near the main entrance sign.
Look for a place where people sit in circles.
Find the final marker by the tallest tree nearby.

medium.description: Campus-wide walk with mixed clue complexity.
clues: Begin where schedules are posted publicly.
Move toward the building with the glass atrium.
Check around the outdoor map for the final clue.

hard.description: Long route with indirect clues and wider search area.
clues: Start from the oldest building plaque you can find.
Head to the path that crosses water or a bridge.
Finish at the landmark visible from the highest point.
